headline: Systems Administrator
summary: Systems administrator with three years looking after servers, users and the network at an agricultural supply company. I keep Windows and Linux servers, the office network and the sales database running, and I automate routine tasks with PowerShell and SQL.
skills: System security: patching, access rights, antivirus

experience.title: Systems Administrator
bullets: Look after 6 servers, 90 user accounts and the network linking the head office with four branch stores.
Set up nightly database backups with a monthly restore drill after a failed disk nearly lost a week of sales.
Wrote PowerShell scripts that create and disable user accounts from an HR list.
Apply monthly patches and keep antivirus and access rights up to date on every server.

experience.title: IT Intern
bullets: Supported staff with computer problems and helped inventory network equipment.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
